notes.title: Complete Loop 1 OST is now available for purchase!
notes.content: [h3]HEY GUYS![/h3][p]We have finally persuaded INSIDIOUS MEATSUCKERS! to grant us the exclusive license to their underworldly music. [/p][p]Negotiating with Sean is hell, 0/10, wouldn't recommend. There was so much yelling in that room, our lawyer is still having trouble hearing with his left ear. [/p][p]But it's done, and now we can announce that [b]the complete OST for TDTMTMTG Loops 0-1 is available for purchase![/b][/p][p]49 minutes 36 seconds of pleasure divided into 17 ridiculously-titled tracks are waiting for you on our Steam page.[/p][p]Happy listening![/p][p][/p][h3]Coming next:[/h3][list][*][p]Larger font option for smaller screens (yes, Steam Deck, we're looking at you);[/p][/*][*][p]The option to storm through dialogues by holding SPACE / A (you asked for it, we're delivering);[/p][/*][*][p]The option to carry your previously revealed traits and clues into a new playthrough;[/p][/*][*][p]Ukrainian localization.[/p][/*][/list][p]🐝 [b]Watch out for bees![/b] 🐝[/p]

notes.title: Update 2025-07-28: Controller Support and many small fixes
The Demo is Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

After long months of hard work, we can finally present to you [b]The Demons Told Me to Make This Game - Public Demo![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3677220/The_Demons_Told_Me_to_Make_This_Game_Demo/

[i]Dark rituals and Blood Sacrifices. Elder Gods and Eldritch Beasts. Demonic Possessions and Hive Minds. 

The world is ending, and the only ones who can save it are a small group of exorcists—young, incompetent, and woefully ill-equipped for the task. They are bound to fail. It’s written. It’s inevitable.

It’s fortunate, then, that an entity capable of rewriting the written and averting the inevitable is on their side.[/i]

[h3]The Content Available in the Demo:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Loop 0: Of Tapes and Gums - complete Loop available;
[*] Loop 1: Of Punks and Bees - Time Slot 1 available;
[/olist]

After playing this demo, you'll have a solid grasp of the game's feel and flow—as well as its setting and main characters.

We’d be incredibly grateful for your feedback on any aspect of the game.

Watch out for bees!
Haunted Dude

notes.title: Watch The Demons Told Me to Make This Game story trailer!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Red Hives is the kind of town that has been dying for decades. A rotting wound of a settlement nuzzled to a lake and surrounded by thick woods. 

Here, the decay doesn’t stop at the surface. The secrets of this place go deep, and the locals seeem to carry something dark in their bones.

When the demons came, it was almost as if the town had been waiting for them.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BgCSWtrq5EQ

Our new story trailer introduces some of the standout residents of Red Hives — including furious Father Benjamin, ancient & wise Mrs. Doomsday, little Tom, enigmatic Beekeeper, and magnificent Jenny the drummer from a local garage band Insidious Meatsuckers! 

Caught in the middle of all this are Gum and Tape, amateur exorcists who are way out of their depth, trapped in a time loop they don’t even know exists, and bound to your possession powers.

[h1]Demo + new gameplay trailer coming soon![/h1]

We’re happy to share that we’re hard at work on a demo for TDTMTMTG. We’re also preparing a new gameplay trailer to highlight the narrative mechanics that will let you explore Red Hives across the timelines created by your choices.

More updates to come soon.
[b]*Booming demonic voice*[/b]: [i]Don’t forget to wishlist the game![/i]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835690/The_Demons_Told_Me_to_Make_This_Game
